Class Topic<K,V>

java.lang.Object
io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.Topic<K,V>
Type Parameters:
K - the key type this topic carries
V - the value type this topic carries
public final class Topic<K,V> extends Object
A typed topic, with its name and codecs declared once and then shared.

Declare each topic exactly once and pass the object around. A pipeline hop is the same Topic appearing as one stage's sink and another's source, so codec agreement across the hop holds by construction.

A topic is also the factory for Emissions to itself. send(Object, Object) is the only way user logic expresses output, and it type-checks the key and value against the topic's codecs at the construction site.
